original.statement: The `boltdb.shipper.compactor.deletion-mode` CLI flag and its YAML setting are removed; use `compactor.deletion-mode` or `deletion_mode` in limits_config instead.

decision.reason: [ev-7b76cb015d7e] says the `boltdb.shipper.compactor.deletion-mode` CLI flag and its YAML setting are removed. It names the `compactor.deletion-mode` CLI flag as the replacement, so the subject (with the leading -- that cli-flag names require) and the change (removed, replacedBy --compactor.deletion-mode) are correct. [ev-f15092605ae3] supports this: compactor flags with the `boltdb.shipper.compactor.` prefix are removed in favour of the `compactor.` prefix. The validator results are inconclusive and contradict nothing.
